review_kind: AI-assisted source-context review. Preserves per-view thresholding before agreement/voting, available probabilities and default. No native-speaker sign-off.

records.source: Probability cutoff (0-1) applied to the model's positive-class score when deriving binary predictions. With test-time augmentation, this threshold labels each view before agreement and voting are calculated. Probability scores remain available. Default 0.5.
records.translation: 生成二元预测时，对模型的正类概率分数应用的阈值（0–1）。使用测试时增强时，先按此阈值对每个视图分类，再计算一致性和投票结果。概率分数仍然可用。默认值为 0.5。
